requirements.title: Look / Style Library
requirements.description: A data-defined, thumbnail-backed, AI-aware library that generalizes presets (OT-P1-010) + recipes (OT-P1-004). A Look = {name, thumbnail, op-chain, prompt template, params} that compiles to {prompt + optional mask/selection + backend params}. Adding a Look auto-generates its preview by applying the Look to a reference image. A UI picker (modal or full-page drawer) presents thumbnails. Film/lens/camera-emulation looks may be pure-deterministic (LUT/grain/vignette) and/or an AI pass.

validation.notes: Look → {prompt + params + ordered steps} compiler: fills the prompt template with the subject, merges Look defaults < step params, flags requires_image, and warns on model-backed steps / missing input.
SQLite CRUD over the built-in seed: slug ids, built-in collision/read-only refusal, kind filter, thumbnail persistence — built-ins stay read-only, custom Looks round-trip.

RenderPreview applies the deterministic step chain in-process to a reference image (film/camera Looks render exactly; AI steps reported as deferred) — the 'adding a Look auto-generates its preview' flow, no model required.
LooksService Connect handler: list/get/create/compile/render-preview end to end over a test DB + blob store; built-in collision → AlreadyExists; built-in preview not persisted.
Looks gallery (Library page): renders built-in + custom Looks with kind/built-in badges and thumbnails, the Preview button renders a preview, and style Looks surface their deferred-steps note.
